title: Temporary Absences from a Memory Care Suite and the Absence Credit
content:
Under the Memory Care Residency Agreement a resident may be away from the suite for a while - a hospital admission, a skilled nursing or rehabilitation stay, or a family visit - without the residency ending. This clause states how the absence is recorded and what it is credited.

## Clause

1. **Recording.** A temporary absence is recorded with its start date and reason, and the residency is then on leave. The suite is held while the monthly rate continues. The resident's return is recorded with its date, and the residency is active again.
2. **Midnights away.** The length of one continuous absence is its midnights away: the return date less the start date, in calendar days (or the handling date less the start date while the resident is still away).
3. **Absence credit.** After return, the credited days are the midnights away less 14, never below zero and never above 30. Each credited day is credited at 25 percent of the daily monthly rate, the daily monthly rate being the monthly rate divided by the days in the month. The credit is one absence credit per absence per billing month, and its amount is the monthly rate divided by the days in the month, multiplied by the days credited and by 25 percent, rounded once to the cent, half up.
4. **Once only.** An absence credit is posted at most once per absence per billing month; the absence is identified by its start date.
5. **Review point.** When an absence reaches 45 midnights, the executive director decides whether the suite continues to be held.

## Credited days for one continuous absence

| Midnights away | Credited days |
|---|---|
| 10 | 0 |
| 14 | 0 |
| 15 | 1 |
| 30 | 16 |
| 44 | 30 |
| 45 | 30 |
| 60 | 30 |

The first 14 midnights are never credited, and the credit stops growing at 30 days, which is reached at 44 midnights.

## Worked figure (hypothetical rate and dates)

A resident whose hypothetical monthly rate is 7200.00 leaves for a hospital stay on 3 March and returns on 25 March. Midnights away: 25 less 3, 22. Credited days: 22 less 14, 8. March has 31 days, so the credit is 7200.00 divided by 31, multiplied by 8 and by 25 percent: 464.516..., posted as 464.52. A second credit for the same absence in March is not posted.

## Basis Q&A

**Is anything credited while the resident is still in hospital?** The credit is calculated after return; while the resident is away the monthly rate continues and the suite is held.

**Is the absence reason relevant to the credit?** The credit is calculated the same way for each of the recorded reasons; the reason is recorded with the start date.
